body:
Parent: #1172

## Problem

Many mobile screens consume a large amount of vertical space with repeated
headers. Tool screens can show a global header, a second Tool header, and then
content. Chat screens can show a breadcrumb/session ID header, a second
session-title/action header, and another settings/files/manage selector.

This is a post-beta UI-density improvement and does not block the first
functional mobile release.

## Outcome

Adopt one compact, consistent screen header that preserves context and primary
actions while moving secondary administration into a three-dot overflow menu.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each Tool and Chat screen has one compact title/navigation header rather
      than stacked large-title/breadcrumb headers.
- [ ] Chat header contains back navigation, human-readable session title,
      concise running/connection status, and a three-dot overflow menu.
- [ ] Settings and Manage move to the overflow menu; Files Changed appears as
      a compact button/badge only when relevant.
- [ ] Tool screens combine Tool identity and applicable actions into the same
      compact header.
- [ ] Raw session IDs and mobile breadcrumbs such as
      `Agents / Chats / <sessionId>` are not used as prominent titles.
- [ ] Safe-area behavior, keyboard presentation, scrolling, VoiceOver,
      Dynamic Type, and landscape layouts remain usable.
- [ ] The change increases usable content height without shrinking touch
      targets below platform guidance.

## Likely files

- `apps/mobile/app/_layout.tsx`
- `apps/mobile/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx`
- `apps/mobile/app/tools/[tool].tsx`
- `apps/mobile/app/agents/chats/[sessionId].tsx`
- `apps/mobile/components/chat/chat-header.tsx`
- `apps/mobile/components/tools/tool-screen-state.tsx`

## Required tests / evaluation

- Route-level header contract preventing duplicate screen titles.
- Screenshot coverage for Agents chat and representative Tool screens.
- Physical-device review at default/largest Dynamic Type, portrait/landscape,
  and with the keyboard visible.

## Safety / out of scope

- Do not hide destructive actions or approval context; keep them explicit and
  confirmed even when launched from overflow.
- Do not reduce touch-target size merely to compress the header.
- Does not block the first functional beta release.
title: iOS: consolidate duplicate large headers into one compact screen toolbar
